For vulnerabilities, use SECURITY.md; never post private records, credentials,
auth state or exploit details here. Current project stage may have no runtime.

## Expected behavior and requirement

Link the FR/D/AC or owning contract; distinguish proposed API from an actual release.

## Actual behavior and minimal synthetic reproduction

Include steps or a safe minimal example, not application/private datasets.

## Environment and evidence

Exact package/tool/browser/OS version or revision/dirty state, processing mode,
enabled features, expected versus observed result and sanitized artifacts.
State which checks were actually run and what is not proven.
